    {
      "skill_id": "mid_smiles_low_halogen",
      "rules": [
        {
          "rule_id": "mid_smiles",
          "conditions": {"smiles_length_bin": "smiles_mid"},
          "weight": -0.5,
          "rationale": "Moderate length molecules balance complexity and affinity."

        {
          "rule_id": "low_halogen",

          "weight": -0.3,
          "rationale": "Low halogen content avoids negative effects on hydration."

      "ridge": 1.0,
      "prior_scale": 0.25,
      "semantic_mass_start": 0.3,
      "semantic_mass_end": 0.1,
      "ucb_weight": 0.6,

      "gp_beta_end": 1.0,
      "gp_xi": 0.01,
      "confidence": 0.7,
      "hypothesis": "Mid-length molecules with low halogen content may avoid negative effects but could fail if halogens are beneficial."

  "selected_skill_id": "short_smiles_high_hetero",
  "lesson": "Shorter molecules with high hetero atoms show potential for maximizing hydration affinity.",
  "revision_summary": "Proposed a new skill focusing on mid-length molecules with low halogen content to explore alternative configurations."
}
